title: adjudication-output
description: The adjudication agent's ENTIRE output for one finding. Deliberately excludes every monetary field (billed_amount, expected_amount, delta, dispute_amount, total_in_dispute, or anything else numeric-financial) -- additionalProperties: false makes it structurally impossible for the agent to introduce one, regardless of what the prompt asks. All money in the final report comes only from Phases 1-4.
